errors.text_span: 带有向右上倾斜斜线纹理的白色柱子代表“本文方法”，右侧带有向右下倾斜斜线纹理的灰色柱子代表“基线模型”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the two methods are differentiated by the direction of the hatching lines ('tilting to the top right' vs 'tilting to the bottom right'). In the figure, the hatching lines for both bar types tilt in the same direction (from top-left to bottom-right). The bars are actually differentiated by their fill color (white vs. grey) and their position within the group (left vs. right).
